description: Decide which work (website, form, shop) is shown at the root of a domain. where=managed: a managed domain, root and www together (domain_id). where=custom: one connected hostname (custom_id). This changes what visitors of the domain see: ask the user before calling this. Pass replace=true only if the user said to replace foreign DNS records.

replace.description: Only for managed: replace foreign DNS records at root and www.

target_kind.description: What should be shown: site, form or shop.

name: set_domain_front
title: Choose what a domain shows
